content.title: Statewide Campuses
content.text: This is OUR STATE At Utah State University, you have choices. No matter where you attend, your diploma will have the three renowned words: Utah State University. Stay close to home Utah State's 30 locations across Utah provide access to a variety of high-caliber programs with personalized support and flexibility to fit your life. live away from home Utah State's residential campuses in Logan, Blanding, and Eastern in Price, provide the state's premier college experience and student life. anywhere, anytime Utah State's Online Campus (USU Online) gives students access to 60+ fully online programs and 600+ courses from anywhere, at any time. Schedule a Campus Tour Be a part of something BIGGER The mission of Utah State University's Statewide Campuses is to provide high-quality and transformative educational opportunities throughout Utah. Our campuses empower individuals to build a better future, engage with communities to fulfill workforce local needs, and create a sustainable foundation based on the importance of purpose and place. Academics WORTH IT We know Utah State is worth it. See why it could be worth it to you. AGGIE IMPACT Utah State Aggies create transformational impacts through meaningful research. You can make an impact too. HANDS-ON LEARNING Diverse programs with hands-on learning opportunities to gain technical knowledge and employable skills for success in today’s workforce. USU Moab helped me reach my education and professional goals by offering flexible online courses and personalized support. This allowed me to gain the skills and knowledge I needed while managing my personal life. The faculty is always accessible and the curriculum's practical focus played a crucial role in preparing me for my career. I love how close to home it is. USU Brigham City also provides personal help from staff and faculty. The higher teacher-to-student ratio and smaller classes really suit my learing style. Plus, I can take online classes and easily pop over to campus for exams. It's perfect for me.
